Benchmark rules (identical for every run): work only inside the current folder; make the video with code — no stock footage, no AI video/image generation, no downloaded media unless the brief names it; deliver the finished file as ./final.mp4 (H.264 video + AAC audio, with sound); when done, reply with its path and two lines on what you built.

tasks.title: Motion-designer showreel
tasks.prompt: make a dynamic 15-second motion graphics video that shows what an incredible motion designer you are, like it's your showreel for a résumé. Go all out.

tasks.title: Logo sting
tasks.prompt: Create a 6-second logo sting for "Northwind Labs", a fictional climate-data startup. Invent a simple mark and a wordmark, reveal them with real impact, and give it sound design (a hit, a whoosh, a short musical resolve). Go all out.

tasks.title: Product launch film
tasks.prompt: Make a 30-second launch film for ARC, a fictional titanium smart ring (the product does not exist, so invent everything). Aim for keynote-level craft: a hero object built from code (procedural 3D, no assets) with believable metal and light, slow macro camera moves, one "inside the ring" exploded moment, three crisp spec call-outs (9-day battery · sleep & HRV · 50 m water resistant) and a final lockup with the name and a tagline you write. Build tension, reveal, pay off. Original score plus foley-style sound design (clicks, air, a deep sub hit on the reveal). Go all out.

tasks.title: Sci-fi teaser trailer
tasks.prompt: Make a 20-second cinematic teaser trailer for a fictional science-fiction film called "LAST SIGNAL" (a lone station keeps receiving a transmission from its own future). Think title cards, camera moves, atmosphere, a build to one huge moment, and a score. No actors, no footage: everything generated. Go all out.

tasks.title: Kinetic typography manifesto
tasks.prompt: Make a 20-second kinetic typography film that delivers this manifesto word for word: "We don't wait for inspiration. We build it. Frame by frame. Line by line. Until the thing you imagined starts to move." Type is the only hero: it must scale, slice, orbit, morph, collide and resolve in time with an original drum-driven track; mix typefaces and weights, include one 3D / perspective moment and one beat of total silence before the last line. Go all out.

tasks.title: App explainer
tasks.prompt: Make a 20-second explainer video for "Pocketwise", a fictional app that turns shared household expenses into a simple monthly summary. Show the problem, the app UI (invent the screens), one satisfying data moment (numbers/chart), and end with the name and a one-line tagline. Original music and UI sound design. Go all out.

tasks.title: Audio-reactive visualizer
tasks.prompt: First compose a 20-second original electronic track (synthesise it yourself), then make an audio-reactive music visualizer for it: the picture must respond to the kick, the bass and the melody, with a build and a drop. No text except a small title at the end. Go all out.

tasks.title: Prestige-drama title sequence
tasks.prompt: Make a 25-second main-title sequence for a fictional prestige thriller series called "THE HOLLOW HOURS" (a night-shift detective in a city that never sleeps). Saul Bass meets a modern streaming title: abstract imagery built from shapes, light, grain and type — cut-paper layers, flickering neon, rain on glass, a clock that unravels — with credit-style typography (invent the credits) and a brooding original score with a heartbeat pulse. Go all out.

tasks.title: Vertical data story
tasks.prompt: Make a 15-second VERTICAL (9:16) social video that tells one statistic in a way people feel: in the fictional city of Lumen, daily bike-share rides grew from 12,000 in 2021 to 87,000 in 2025. Hook in the first second, one hero visual, big readable numbers, music with a drop. Safe areas for phone UI. Go all out.

tasks.title: Seamless abstract loop
tasks.prompt: Create an 8-second SEAMLESS looping abstract animation for a website hero background: dark, elegant, one accent colour, slow organic motion, no text. The last frame must flow into the first without a visible jump. A quiet ambient audio bed is welcome. Go all out.
